description: Run the project's tools for real, each with the "example" input from its tools/doc/<name>.json, the way the agent will (JSON on stdin, project folder as working directory, the tool's timeout_s). Reports per tool: ok or FAILED, exit code, stdout and stderr. Use it after writing or changing a tool, and fix every FAILED before building.

dir.description: Agent project directory, relative to the working directory. Default: the working directory itself.

tool.description: Test only this tool (its name in tools/bin). Default: every tool.
